text:
Situation: Imipenem and cilastatin vials (NDC 44567-705-10, SPL set ID 46f54df9-5afe-430c-aa19-0d84c2044b0b) labeled by WG Critical Care, LLC and manufactured at Zambon Switzerland Ltd. in Cadempino are used at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside. Corvale East holds 66 vials (4 days supply). Corvale General holds 472.5 vials (29.5 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 105 vials (29.8 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows two Merck Sharp & Dohme entries for imipenem-containing products, both status To Be Discontinued, with initial posting dates 2026-01-08 and 2026-09-09. Neither entry references the WG Critical Care NDC or the Zambon plant. FDA has not posted a shortage signal for the WG Critical Care product manufactured at Zambon Switzerland.

Our position: The supply pressure at Corvale East reflects local demand rather than a federally tracked shortage. Internal inventory can cover the gap.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 55 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 166 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — needs buyer.
4. Buy from Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC — needs buyer.

Not recommended: No action beyond the transfers and purchases listed.
